hash_and_length_once.note: slice_hash runs the keyed FNV-1a itself, eight bytes per loop step with the tail byte by byte (the same xor and multiply chain, so the same value for every length), and Bloom::add and Bloom::contains read the bit length once, return for an empty filter and take the remainder by a length known to be non-zero, instead of a checked remainder per key. Bits, counts and answers are unchanged.
